lines.t: What is love…
If I could find the words…
Love is patient, it waits without rushing
Love is kind, with a gentle hand
It does not envy what another is given
Does not boast or demand to be seen
It walks in humility, quiet and steady
Not lifted in pride or its own name
It honors others with pure intention
Never seeking its own gain
This is love…
Steady as the rising sun
This is love…
When all is said and done
It won’t break, it won’t run
Through the fire or the flood
Always holding on…
This is love
It is not quick to burn into anger
It lets go of the wrongs that were done
It keeps no list of every failure
Mercy outweighs what has come
It finds no joy in darkness or evil
But rejoices in all that is true
It stands in the light of what’s righteous
And is faithful in all that it proves
This is love…
Steady as the rising sun
This is love…
When all is said and done
It won’t break, it won’t run
Through the fire or the flood
Always holding on…
This is love
It always protects, it always keeps
It always trusts, it still believes
It always hopes when hope feels gone
It carries on… and on… and on…
This is love…
Unshaken, ever strong
This is love…
Where every heart belongs
Through every trial and test
It rises far above
It never fails…
This is love
What is love…
It never fails…
